svg.title: ACMF: confidence-guided multi-scale fusion
svg.desc: A fungal micrograph feeds two ViT-B/16 models at 224 and 384 pixels. Each outputs class probabilities; each is weighted by inverse Shannon entropy and the weighted sum gives the fused prediction.
svg.text: Two ViT-B/16 models read the same micrograph at 224 px and 384 px. The more confident one gets more weight.
